analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 54.5, down from 55.7 five days ago, remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram is improving (-3.1958 to -2.0415) but still negative. Volume ratio of 0.65 indicates contraction, and the price failed to break the 500.76 resistance. While a Higher Low pattern is maintained from the 20-day low of 486.00 to the 5-day low of 491.10, the price is range-bound below the 500.76 resistance, showing a lack of directional conviction.

· 현재가($497.93) vs SMA5($498.38)/SMA20($499.49)/SMA50($473.09): SMA5/20 하회, SMA50 상회하며 단기 약세 전환, 중기 추세는 상회 유지.

· 52주 위치 72.7% + 현 가격대 역사적 고점 대비 약 10% 하락 구간.
[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (55.7→54.5): 중립 구간 지속 및 소폭 하락, 방향성 부재 확인.
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-3.1958→-2.0415): 음수 구간에서 개선 중이나 여전히 약세 수렴 신호.
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치(중단 $499.49 근처): 중단 부근 횡보하며 방향성 결여.
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($493.25): 20일 저가 기반으로 한 지지선.
· 스윙 저항선 ($500.76): 피벗(PP)과 일치하며 단기 저항 구간.
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴: 5일 저가($491.10) > 20일 저가($486.00)로 Higher Low 패턴 유지, 5일 고가($509.44) < 20일 고가($517.78)로 Lower High 패턴 형성되며 횡보 구간 진단.
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.65배): 5일 평균 대비 위축된 거래량으로 움직임의 신뢰도 하락.
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간): RSI 중립, MACD 개선 중이나 음수, 거래량 위축, 저항선 돌파 실패로 방향성 부재. 관망 조건 충족.
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($497.93) vs SMA5 ($498.38) / SMA20 ($499.49) / SMA50 ($473.09): Below SMA5/20, above SMA50, indicating a short-term shift to weakness while mid-term trend remains above.
· Above SMA100 ($437.11) / SMA200 ($430.47) by 15.67%, maintaining mid-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position at 72.7% + Current price level is approximately 10% below historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (55.7 → 54.5): Neutral zone sustained with a slight decrease, confirming lack of directional momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-3.1958 → -2.0415): Improving within negative territory, still signaling bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Near Mid Band $499.49): Range-bound near the mid-band, indicating a lack of direction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($493.25): Support level based on the 20-day low.
· Swing Resistance ($500.76): Aligns with the Pivot Point (PP), acting as short-term resistance.
· 5-day / 20-day High/Low Pattern: 5-day low ($491.10) > 20-day low ($486.00) maintains a Higher Low pattern, while 5-day high ($509.44) < 20-day high ($517.78) forms a Lower High pattern, diagnosing a range-bound phase.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.65x): Below the 5-day average volume, reducing the conviction of price movements.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Neutral RSI, improving but negative MACD, contracted volume, and failure to break resistance indicate a lack of direction. Conditions for observation met.
